name: data-cap-example-flow-explorer
description: Tier 4 -- a data-flow explorer. One evidence file (docs/data.evidence.json) is the only input; a devDependency renderer (@viz-js/viz) and a few lines of browser code turn it into an interactive, keyboard-operable, accessible view. Also writes every standards-based export (Mermaid, DOT, PROV, SARIF, OSCAL, OpenTelemetry) and is the end-to-end regression test for the flow analysis.
